prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return solution.go in package solution.
Required API: func QuotaLedger(input string) (string, bool)
Behavior: Parse limit;account:delta records. Limit is a canonical unsigned decimal in 0..10000000; accounts use ASCII [a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*; deltas are canonical signed decimals in -10000000..10000000. Apply in order from zero and reject any balance below zero or above limit. Return all touched account balances sorted by account.
Visible example: 10;a:4,b:3,a:-1 returns a=3,b=3.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
